Differentiating Gaussian images gives a uniform short-time boundary expansion; a proved log-concavity-of-integrated-tails lemma shows the new cumulative profile has exactly one strict maximizing positive root. Uniform localization and curvature stability yield two short-time knots. The integrated Fourier correction has a uniformly bounded second derivative, proving strict concavity and unique midpoint at horizons >=1/2. The accompanying checker passes 1340 finite supplementary checks; it is not substituted for continuum proofs.
